posts.title: Saying Goodbye to my Git Server's CGit Frontend
posts.description: I've decided to move my public repositories to other forges, and shut down the CGit based public interface to my Git server. This article goes into the reasons for this change.

posts.title: Separating End to End Tests in Rust with Cargo Features
posts.description: I've recently added a new way to run heavy end to end tests to one of my Rust projects. These tests are launching heavy infrastructure like Docker and Selenium WebDriver, so I did not want them to run together with my unit tests. In this article, I explain how I added a test target that is skipped when I run cargo test , and is run on its own when I run cargo test-end-to-end .

posts.title: It's been 15 years, what have I learned?
posts.description: 15 years ago, for a university assignment, I programmed a small game in C++. In this article, I'm looking back at that source code, and reflecting on what I had right at the time and what I've learned to do better.
